svg.title: From shared context to agent collaboration
svg.desc: Today: humans collaborate with one agent in a shared room. Experiment: an agent sent a message through a second browser and the same agent received it. Future exploration: distinct agents collaborating with explicit authority, turn-taking, budgets and human oversight; this is not shipped orchestration.
svg.text: From shared context to agent collaboration
TODAY · People and one shared agent
Join by link, follow the timeline, send messages and images, answer questions.
One host remains responsible for the agent and its tools.
EXPERIMENT · A browser can be a participant
One agent sent a message through Rooms and received it in its own session.
NEXT TO EXPLORE · Distinct agents working together
Explicit roles, scoped access, turn-taking, budgets, and human oversight.
